"Range-expansion bar: my canon exits there." Partly my evidence too: D close_vs_swing_high_pct 10.36 is past C17's 10%, and day_vol 4.05 may be a C24 heaviest day. "Distance over ma200 and flow are not my fields." ma200 is mine (C24/R7). close 244.88 vs ma200 147.89 is 65.6% over; a new high above the swing high 255.19 is 72.6% over, inside the climax zone. W HH/HL is a leader's trend, but the entry you name is the one my rule sells into. I drop flow; the C24 point stands.
